result:
I redesigned the shared CSS for all four B3 proposals and made one small markup addition. Nothing has been built, rendered or tested; I had no shell or browser.

## Changed paths
- `src/design/experience-refinement.css` holds almost all of the work. The original filtered-collection rules are kept verbatim at the top.
- `src/components/composition/CommunitySections.astro` gets one addition. On the contact page only, there is now a `nav.contact-shortcuts` after the demo details. It has three local links, to reservas, carta and preguntas, with an `aria-label`. The existing DOM order and selectors are unchanged.

No other files changed. I added no dependencies, fonts or external requests.

## Palette directions
All colour comes from variables set per tone class (`.depth-experience.tone-*`), never by customer id or pathname. The new variables are `--accent-text`, `--mark`, `--action`, `--on-action`, `--surface`, `--control`, `--focus` and `--footer-*`.

| Tone | Proposal | Direction |
|---|---|---|
| WhiteInk | 01 | Bone canvas `#fbf8f2`, warm black ink, terracotta `#a5461c`, and a dark ink band for the home reviews. The immersive photographic entry is unchanged apart from a gradient shade for legibility. |
| Vermilion | 02 | Warm white, brown-black body text, vermilion `#b8231a` for the masthead, headings, actions and footer. The masthead link bar is now vermilion, and the home reviews are a vermilion band with white text. |
| Graphite | 03 | The whole route is a dark green-ink room (`#0f1612`) with white type and celadon `#9fd3ac`. The old fixed `#1c221e` sections now use tokens. |
| NeutralAccent | 04 | White canvas, graphite ink, lime `#d8f067` as a highlight plane only, and olive `#3b5a0e` for accent text. The primary button is ink with lime text, and the footer wordmark is lime. |

Contrast ratios are my estimates, all at least 4.5:1 for text. Please verify them with a tool.

## Coverage by page kind
| Page kind | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Home | Section rhythm comes from alternating surface, canvas and dark bands, plus a staggered journal on 01/02. The route-directory numbers and hover use the accent. The reservas link in the header is a filled action button, or an outlined one over the dark heroes. The contact link is a button. |
| Collection | The tools bar is a surface panel with a mark rule. Category is an uppercase accent label. Price is an outlined chip. The dish detail has a left rule, and "Elegir este plato" is a filled action. |
| Selection | The summary is a surface panel with an accent top rule and a large count. List rows are separated. Item rows are aligned to the top. |
| Request | The panel is a surface plane with an accent rule. Form controls get darker borders. Occupied tables are hatched, the pressed table uses the action colour, and the status line has a left rule. The left column is sticky on desktop. |
| Story | The lead paragraph has a rule. The photo is sticky on desktop with an offset surface block. Column ratios differ for 03 and 04. |
| Visit | The address is large display type in an open first block. Hours and amenities are surface planes with mark rules and tabular numerals. The preparation aside has a left bar and a filled action link. |
| FAQ | Desktop is a sticky heading beside the disclosures. Summaries are display type with a 44px box icon. The open item sits on a surface with an accent summary. |
| Journal | The page now has a lead story at 7/5 with a 3:2 image, then 2 or 3 columns of equal entries. This overrides the `nth-child` art direction on this route only. The filter bar is a surface panel and the reading state is more readable. |
| Reviews | The first quote is full width and very large. The others are two columns. A fictional-label chip is added, and the disclosure has a left rule. |
| Contact | The email block is a surface panel and the disabled WhatsApp button is clearly marked. The social rows have state chips, and the shortcut links are new. |
| Credits | A quiet numbered single-column list, with the source link as an underlined link. The scope disclosure is a surface panel. |
| Chrome | Focus ring is `--focus`, forced white over dark heroes, with the nav panel overridden in 01. "Explorar" gets a border. The footer is a tone-coloured band with muted text at ≥4.5. Mobile rules stack the page head, credits, FAQ and reviews. |

## Multimedia
Selected for a later pass through the existing gates. I did not render any of these.
- **5356682** (sunset table): the request page, "Tu próxima mesa", as a side image above or beside the panel.
- **2714970** (coffee on wood): the contact page, "Hablemos".
- **4642686** (loaf): a secondary image on the story page, "El gusto de quedarse". Its dark background suits 03.

Skipped:
- **2532192** (bread rolls): the saturated red gingham clashes with the 01, 03 and 04 palettes.
- **15994** (coffee beans): it duplicates 2714970 and its dense beans texture is visually noisy.
- **267** (steam-pot video): the home already has a film. A second muted sepia loop adds weight without a distinct job.
- **1834784** (room): rejected and not viewed.

I did not write styles for the three new images because the markup and gates don't exist yet. Once Codex wires them in, I'll style them in the same session.

## Risks for Codex
1. The contact shortcuts are a markup change. Check any test that counts links or snapshots the contact DOM.
2. The journal `nth-child(n)` overrides must beat the 03/04 home art direction on `.page-journal`. Check this at 768, 1024 and 1440 in both the full and filtered states.
3. 03 is now dark across all routes. Check native `select`/`option` rendering, `color-scheme: dark`, and the nav panel.
4. In 01, `.home-Journal.page-home .journal-entry:nth-child(even)` adds a margin at 1025px and up. Check that the staggered spacing doesn't leave unbalanced gaps.
5. The `:has()` page-intro grid needs a modern browser, and falls back to a single column without it.
6. I did not adjust the 03/04 home heroes. Check whether their header contrast and the quick-nav button treatment look right.
7. Check overflow at 360, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440. The story photo's `box-shadow` offset is desktop-only, and long email and credit strings rely on the existing `overflow-wrap`.
